scope: Independent local raw read-phase/offer/barrier/prefix/arrival closure, not a capacity comparison or independent packet-to-Image proof. No Java, cluster, network, SSH, SQL or business operation.

rawPhases.timingScope: Phase min reservation start through max coordinator end is an observed lower bound, not exact bank lifetime. Per RPC coordinator end is after logical reply flush, before timing flush/consume. Elapsed includes ordered head wait and overlapping read intervals; retained capacity is source-enforced/runtime-attested, without independent consume timestamps.
